_comment: Points this machine's AI tools at the hub through cc-switch, which is what people already use to keep several providers on one machine. Two steps, offered separately: installing cc-switch, and activating — registering the hub in it as a provider and switching to it. Activating keeps a copy of each tool's configuration as it stood, and deactivating puts that copy back exactly, leaving cc-switch and its other providers in place. An existing cc-switch, desktop app or CLI, is detected rather than reinstalled; the two share one store, so a provider registered by the CLI shows up in the desktop app.
name: ai_tools
title: AI tools
description: cc-switch, with this hub as a provider for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini
_comment_switcher: cc-switch-cli shares its store with the cc-switch desktop app, so installing either shows the same providers. Assets are published for x86_64 and aarch64 only; the platforms absent here fall back to direct config writes.
